title: 第15章 火力不足恐惧症第16章 放逐
lines: 当宙斯、波塞冬与哈迪斯平安归营，与赫拉等人汇合时，整个新生神族阵营爆发出了惊天动地的欢呼。
盖亚的预言正在一步步化为现实，胜利的天平，似乎已无可逆转地开始倾斜。
所有人都意识到，泰坦与新生神族之间绵延十年的战争，终于迎来了最终决战的曙光。
“宙斯，虽然盖亚大人的预言正在应验，形势对我们有利，但此刻绝不能掉以轻心。”
营帐内，墨提斯依偎在宙斯身旁，红发如瀑，美丽的脸上却带着挥之不去的忧虑。
“我知道，墨提斯。”
宙斯握着她的手，感受着掌心传来的温度与支持。
“直到现在，我们依然没能真正在正面彻底压制住父神克洛诺斯。他的时间与收获权能太过难缠，底蕴也比我们深厚。”
“哼！什么父神？”
赫拉冷哼一声，打断了宙斯略带感慨的话语。
她此刻已换上了一身便于战斗的暗红色贴身战甲，勾勒出惊心动魄的曲线，赤发束成利落的马尾，绝美的脸庞上满是杀伐决断。
“他不过是我们必须打倒的敌人罢了！如今有百臂巨人们拖住泰坦大军的主力，我们正好可以集中力量，彻底解决掉克洛诺斯这个祸首！”
墨提斯的担忧是基于全局的缜密，赫拉的提议则是基于破局的锐气。
但身为“异数”的波塞冬深知，因自己的存在，预言的走向早已变得比原版神话更加扑朔迷离。
这并不代表他们现在没有压制甚至击败克洛诺斯的力量。问题在于——
“赫拉，想法是好的。但我们没法把全部精力都放在克洛诺斯一个人身上。泰坦大军虽然被百臂巨人震慑，但基数庞大，高端战力依旧不少。我们这边的高端战力，满打满算就我们六个，加上刚救出来的巨人们。”
波塞冬靠在帐柱上，双手抱胸，泼了盆冷水。
“波塞冬说得对。我和德墨忒尔光是保护追随我们的众多女神、宁芙以及后方补给线，抵御泰坦的偷袭与渗透，就已经耗去了大部分精力。
赫斯提亚温柔却坚定的话语响起，此时她换下了常穿的素雅长裙，穿着一身点缀着永恒之火纹路的银白色轻甲，白金色长发简单束起，碧眸中带着疲惫。
德墨忒尔也跟着点了点头，她身披淡金色的藤蔓状轻甲，手中握着一柄象征丰饶与束缚的麦穗权杖，一脸温柔的附和着。
赫拉沉默了。
她不得不承认，两位姐妹说得是事实。高端战力的对决固然重要，但战争的胜利同样依赖于中低层的稳定与后勤的保障。
她们几人再强，也无法分身万千，面面俱到。
就在这时，帐帘被掀开。
三尊如同小山般的身影弯着腰挤了进来，正是独眼巨人三兄弟，雷神布隆忒斯、闪电神斯特洛佩斯、电光神阿尔戈斯。
“偶然路过，听到了你们的烦恼。”
content_en:
When Zeus, Poseidon and Hades returned to camp safely and joined Hera and others, the entire camp of the newborn gods burst into earth-shattering cheers.
Gaia's prophecy is becoming reality step by step, and the balance of victory seems to have begun to tilt irreversibly.
Everyone realized that the ten-year war between the Titans and the new gods finally ushered in the dawn of the final battle.
"Zeus, although Lord Gaia's prophecy is coming true and the situation is favorable to us, we must not take it lightly at this moment."
In the tent, Metis was nestling next to Zeus, with red hair like a waterfall, but lingering worry on his beautiful face.
"I know, Metis."
Zeus held her hand, feeling the warmth and support from his palm.
"Until now, we have still not been able to completely suppress Father God Cronus from the front. His time and harvest power are too difficult to deal with, and his background is deeper than ours."
"Hmph! What Father God?"
Hera snorted, interrupting Zeus' slightly emotional words.
At this moment, she had put on a dark red body-hugging armor that was suitable for fighting, outlining her thrilling curves. Her red hair was tied into a neat ponytail, and her beautiful face was full of determination to kill.
"He is just an enemy we must defeat! Now that the hundred-armed giants are holding back the main force of the Titan army, we can just concentrate our efforts to completely eliminate Cronus, the culprit!"
Metis's concern was based on the carefulness of the overall situation, while Hera's proposal was based on the determination to break the situation.
But as an "outlier", Poseidon knew that because of his existence, the direction of the prophecy had already become more complicated and confusing than the original myth.
This does not mean that they do not have the power to suppress or even defeat Cronus now. The problem is——
"Hera, the idea is good. But we can't put all our energy on Cronus alone. Although the Titan army was frightened by the hundred-armed giant, it still has a huge base and a lot of high-end combat power. Our high-end combat power here is only six of us, plus the Titans we just rescued."
Poseidon leaned against the tent post, crossed his arms, and poured cold water on him.
"Poseidon is right. Demeter and I have spent most of our energy just protecting the many goddesses, nymphs and rear supply lines who follow us, and resisting Titan sneak attacks and penetrations.
Hestia's gentle but firm words sounded. At this time, she changed out of the simple and elegant dress she usually wore, and wore a silver-white light armor dotted with eternal fire patterns. Her long white-blond hair was simply tied up, and her blue eyes were full of exhaustion.
Demeter also nodded. She was wearing light golden vine-like armor, holding a wheat scepter that symbolized fertility and restraint, and agreed with a gentle look on her face.
Hera was silent.
She had to admit that what the two sisters said was true. The showdown of high-end combat power is important, but the victory of the war also depends on the stability and logistical support of the middle and lower levels.
No matter how strong they are, they can't cover everything.
At this moment, the curtain was opened.
Three hill-like figures bent over and squeezed in. They were the three Cyclops brothers, Brontes, the god of thunder, Stropes, the god of lightning, and Argos, the god of lightning.
“I passed by by chance and heard your troubles. "
